Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
item.description: Yes Bank has filed a petition with the Supreme Court to review an order from October 15. This order upheld a Bombay High Court ruling that quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds. These bonds, worth Rs 8,415 crore, were questioned during Yes Bank's financial difficulties. The high court ruled that the bank's administrator lacked authority for such a write-off.

item.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
item.description: RHI Magnesita has reported a remarkable surge in net profit, soaring to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The consolidated revenues experienced a modest increase, hitting Rs 1,038.26 crore this period. Additionally, overall expenses decreased to Rs 953.06 crore compared to the last year. EBITDA saw a 30 percent growth, reflecting operational enhancements despite challenging economic conditions.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd has filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering with regulatory bodies. This IPO features an offer for sale of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares from Coal India, amounting to a 10 percent stake in the subsidiary MCL. The intended capital raise is around Rs 9,500 crore, with the final execution reliant on regulatory approval and market conditions.

item.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
item.description: The Nifty's current technical structure remains positive. Although a sharp rebound from the vicinity of the 200-week moving average has significantly improved the near-term technical setup, the Index is near its overhead resistance area.

item.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
item.description: Of these, we shortlisted 8 stocks that consistently gained throughout the period, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 7% to 11%.

item.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
item.description: Binance is set to restore withdrawals across all networks and assets by the end of next week. This decision comes after recovering 95% of the $6.3 billion lost in the October hack, which the FBI attributes to North Korean actors, though the nation denies any involvement. Binance pledges to fully reimburse affected clients as operations return to normal.

item.title: Base metals lose momentum amid strong dollar and demand concerns
item.description: One of the key reasons behind the weakness in base metals is the strength of the US dollar. The Dollar Index (DXY) has climbed to the 103-104 range, supported by resilient US economic data, elevated Treasury yields, and expectations that the Federal Reserve may keep interest rates relatively restrictive for longer.

item.title: 6 out of 10 top performing largecap stocks in November delivered multibagger returns in long run. Do you own any?
item.description: Here are the 10 largecap stocks that recorded the biggest jump in November so far, including six who have delivered multibagger returns in the longer run.

item.title: Anthropic IPO buyers have more influence on price than SpaceX
item.description: Anthropic PBC is gearing up for its initial public offering, setting ambitious price targets to capture investor interest. The firm aspires to achieve record fundraising that could eclipse SpaceX's previous achievements. High-profile tech investors back Anthropic's private financing, indicating strong market confidence. Its traditional IPO pricing strategy, distinct from SpaceX's, positions Anthropic to navigate through the challenges of market fluctuations smoothly.

item.title: Wall Street’s wild ride delivers big paydays and bigger bruises
item.description: Market volatility continues as investors navigate significant fluctuations in stock and bond prices this month. Despite challenging conditions, billions are flowing into both index funds and speculative assets. Retail investors are capitalizing on short-term opportunities while the overall market remains fragile. Many professional investors are taking a defensive stance, opting for high-quality assets amid economic uncertainty. This environment highlights the persistent appeal of diversified investing strategies among market participants.

item.title: Nvidia has worst week since Trump tariff selloff as Huang exits
item.description: Nvidia Corp. has witnessed a drastic stock plunge after the ousting of CEO Jensen Huang amid scandals. A staggering 13% decrease in stock value within a week represents its most significant drop since April 2025. With analysts downgrading their ratings, concerns regarding Nvidia's future performance and corporate culture have emerged.

item.title: Bitcoin’s billion-dollar wipeouts are becoming a familiar sight
item.description: Bitcoin liquidation events exceeding $500 million have become common, reflecting significant market volatility. Recent trading sessions have seen large losses, including a $1.3 billion liquidation. Factors affecting the market include high oil prices and potential Federal Reserve rate hikes. Additionally, investors seem to be favoring artificial intelligence stocks over cryptocurrencies amid a tech selloff. These trends indicate an evolving landscape in the crypto trading environment.

item.title: 5 world market themes for the week ahead
item.description: Nvidia's recent leadership change and the upcoming IPO of Anthropic could significantly influence the AI market dynamics. US-China relations are set for discussions as Trump and Xi meet amid various geopolitical concerns. Oil prices remain volatile due to Middle East tensions and supply changes, affecting potential inflation relief. A UK and EU summit aims to advance post-Brexit cooperation on trade and regulations.

item.title: AI rockets to top of worries about financial system in latest Fed survey
item.description: Artificial intelligence has emerged as a top concern for financial stability, according to a recent report from the Federal Reserve. A staggering 87% of respondents cited AI as a key risk, bringing attention to potential cyber threats and declining corporate earnings. There’s been a dramatic increase in debt tied to AI infrastructure investments.

item.title: Fed's Jefferson says he is taking his policy cues from inflation
item.description: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson emphasized inflation as the main factor in determining monetary policy. He highlighted that economic growth and a stable labor market have been observed. Jefferson indicated that upcoming adjustments to policy should rely on data trends and the evolving economic outlook. Concerns about artificial intelligence displacing workers were also mentioned in his remarks.

item.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Nvidia results, Anthropic IPO pose tests for tumultuous AI trade
item.description: Nvidia is poised for a critical quarterly earnings report amidst controversies and leadership changes. Investors are wary as Anthropic prepares for a significant initial public offering, valued at up to $1.4 trillion. The overall market sentiment towards AI stocks could shift based on these developments next week. Retail sales data will also provide insight into consumer health and inflation pressures.

item.title: US Supreme Court to consider lawsuit over Robinhood's 2021 IPO
item.description: Robinhood Markets has filed an appeal with the US Supreme Court concerning a class action lawsuit brought forth by investors. The lawsuit claims the company misled investors ahead of its IPO in July 2021 by not revealing how reduced trading volumes would affect their investments. After initially dismissing the case, the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals has reopened it, with Supreme Court deliberations expected by late June.

item.title: Goldman Sachs sees S&P 500 rising to 8,700 next year despite slower earnings growth
item.description: According to Goldman Sachs, the S&P 500 index may reach 8,700 points within the next year, despite a decline in tech shares after the midterm elections in the US. They foresee a notable deceleration in global earnings growth by 2027, mainly in the US. Nevertheless, Goldman remains optimistic about equity valuations, indicating good returns are possible, and they have revised ratings for different regions while bracing for increased volatility.

item.title: Softbank further trims India exposure, offloads Meesho shares worth Rs 1,885 cr
item.description: In the latest transaction, SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC, an affiliate of SoftBank, offloaded 7.64 crore shares in Bengaluru-based Meesho, according to the block deal data on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

item.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic hit with lawsuit to halt AI development
item.description: A group of nonprofits has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, Anthropic, and other tech companies. They seek to prevent further development of advanced AI models citing potential harm to humanity. Company leaders have raised concerns about the dangers associated with artificial intelligence technologies. The lawsuit relies on California's laws regarding unfair business practices for its basis. If successful, this could significantly impact the future of AI development in these companies.

item.title: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
item.description: Investors based in mainland China and Hong Kong are excluded from placing orders in Anthropic's IPO. This decision reflects the strategic sensitivities between Washington and Beijing regarding technology advancements. Some investors are exploring alternative methods to participate in the public offering through offshore structures. Anthropic intends to complete its IPO on November 18, pricing the shares ahead of trading the next day.

item.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
item.description: BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors. Other banks like Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also revised their forecasts in light of recent data.

item.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
item.description: US stocks fell as Nvidia’s leadership turmoil triggered a broad technology selloff, sending the Nasdaq down 1.42% and the S&P 500 nearly 1% lower. Softer-than-expected producer inflation offered little relief as investors weighed the outlook for interest rates and the wider AI trade.

item.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
item.description: Chicago Fed president Austan Goolsbee stated that inflation has moved beyond temporary energy and tariff-related price shocks. He highlighted that increased demand from the AI buildout is pushing prices higher across many sectors including health care and services. Goolsbee emphasized the importance of upcoming inflation data for determining the Fed's rate increase pace. He noted that currently, there is no clear path back to the 2% inflation target.

item.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
item.description: During his speech, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent advocated for the Federal Reserve to keep an open mind about interest rate adjustments. He pointed out that the current economic indicators could be skewed due to a supply shock from the ongoing conflict in Iran. Despite recent market volatility, Bessent stressed that the US economy remains robust.

item.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
item.description: MAN Industries (India) Ltd has announced a substantial increase in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also saw a notable rise year-on-year, reflecting strong performance. The acquisition of National Pipe Company has positively impacted scale and profitability for the firm. Shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily affected revenue but shipments are being executed.

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq close lower as rate-hike bets pressure US stocks: Stock Market Highlights
Godrej Properties buys 31-acre land in Indore for Rs 130 cr to build housing project
item.description: Godrej Properties Ltd has successfully purchased a sprawling 31 acres of land in Indore for approximately Rs 130 crore. The company is set to embark on the creation of residential plots, providing an impressive saleable area of around 0.7 million square feet. This project marks the firm's third venture in Indore, reflecting a commitment to addressing the rising demand for thoughtfully designed communities.

item.title: German yields set for biggest weekly rise in two months
item.description: As traders ramp up their expectations for European Central Bank interest rate hikes, yields on German government bonds are climbing steadily. This shift follows US inflation figures that were unexpectedly high, disrupting the bond market landscape. Meanwhile, global stock indices are witnessing a downturn, impacting the demand for traditionally safe assets.

item.title: India 10-year bond yield reverses half of last week's drop on elevated inflation
item.description: Indian government bonds fell for a third consecutive session, driven by inflation and interest-rate outlook concerns. The benchmark yield increased to 7.3079%, reversing much of last week's gains. Retail inflation in India accelerated, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's target range, which raises rate hike expectations. In the US, rising Treasury yields and inflation data led to altered rate hike projections.

item.title: How US tech pain is European stock markets' gain
item.description: European stock markets, particularly the STOXX 600, are performing well as tech turmoil affects global markets. This relative stability is attributed to Europe's lower exposure to tech giants compared to the US market. Companies in sectors such as energy and financials are supporting earnings growth, which is on track for 25% quarterly profit. Investors remain cautious, noting that broader market selloffs could still impact Europe.

item.title: Razorpay, Sembcorp Green Infra get Sebi nod to float IPOs
item.description: Razorpay Software Ltd and Sembcorp Green Infra recently received approval from Sebi for their initial public offerings, marking a major milestone in their growth journeys. Razorpay aims to secure Rs 5,000-6,000 crore to enhance its financial services platform, while Sembcorp Green Infra plans to raise Rs 3,750 crore to bolster its renewable energy initiatives.

item.title: Mutlibaggers: 7 stocks held by 100+ MF schemes in October rally up to 300% in FY27
item.description: An ETMarkets analysis identified seven stocks held by over 100 mutual fund schemes that have more than doubled in FY27 so far. Sterlite Technologies led with 303% gains, followed by Welspun Corp, Ather Energy and Laurus Labs.

item.title: Jagatjit Industries Q2 net loss narrows to Rs 4 cr, revenue rises 90%
item.description: Jagatjit Industries Ltd has reported a net loss of Rs 3.96 crore for the second quarter of FY27, significantly improving from Rs 27.91 crore lost during the same period last year. Total income surged to Rs 195.43 crore, up from Rs 103.11 crore. In the first half of FY27, the company posted an overall net loss of Rs 12.23 crore, a decrease from Rs 37.81 crore.

item.title: Indian rupee snaps rising streak on hawkish Fed, oil rise
item.description: In the past week, the Indian rupee faced downward pressure due to escalating oil prices. Although foreign investments offered some relief, they were insufficient to trigger a notable rebound. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to step in to boost forex reserves when the rupee shows strength. Furthermore, India's trade deficit in merchandise hit a yearly peak, compounding the rupee's challenges.

item.title: Cisco shares rally after earnings beat: 6 key things investors need to know
item.description: Cisco shares surge after strong Q1 FY2027 results, beating analyst estimates. Robust AI data-centre demand drives revenue growth, prompting the networking giant to raise its annual revenue and earnings forecasts.

item.title: Tesla-SpaceX Merger: Musk eyes December deal announcement
item.description: Tesla and SpaceX are reportedly advancing merger talks, with a potential December announcement. The proposed $3.5 trillion-plus deal could unite their AI, robotics, automotive and aerospace businesses.

item.title: MSCI rejig: Which stocks may see the biggest inflows & outflows?
item.description: In a significant update, MSCI has revealed modifications to its indices, impacting several Indian stocks starting November 30. This shift is predicted to boost India's representation within the MSCI Emerging Markets Index. Notable stocks like Coforge and LIC are anticipated to attract considerable investments, while PI Industries may experience a decline.

item.title: Carlsberg said to start road show for $600 million India IPO
item.description: Carlsberg is preparing a potential $600 million IPO of its Indian business, targeting a $4 billion valuation. The offering could launch as early as January 2027, comprising a 15% stake sale by its Danish parent. Strong IPO demand in India supports the listing outlook, with Carlsberg India reporting robust revenue.

item.title: Top pension fund to buy more India state bonds on high yields
item.description: SBI Pension Fund plans to increase investments in state government bonds, expecting higher yields amid rising supply. The $64 billion fund is pursuing a carry-focused strategy, favouring state and corporate debt for steady income. It also plans to increase large-cap equity exposure while maintaining a cautious approach towards bond duration.

item.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
item.description: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.
